about: Nicholas I. Timko, managing partner of the New York City firm of Kahn Gordon Timko & Rodriques P.C., has dedicated his professional career to representing individuals who have been seriously injured in all types of accidents. He has represented clients in cases involving unsafe conditions in buildings and on sidewalks, roadways, subways and construction sites, defective products, vehicle accidents, and medical malpractice.

An experienced trial attorney who has won many substantial verdicts, Mr. Timko has been successful in holding corporations, businesses, government agencies, hospitals, doctors, manufacturers and individuals accountable when their conduct causes harm and loss to members of the public. He has been actively involved with the New York State Trial Lawyers Association, currently serving as president and working to protect the rights of all New Yorkers. Mr. Timko has practiced law for more than 25 years and has lectured at continuing legal education seminars.
honors: Past President New York State Trial Lawyers Association
